final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT production_type_code AS c, AVG(unit_price) AS t FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS a FROM Products), s3 AS (SELECT s1.c AS c, s1.t AS t, s1.t - s2.a AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.t > s2.a), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(t) AS m FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.c AS c, s3.t AS t, s3.d AS d, s3.t - s4.m AS e FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.t > s4.m) SELECT AVG(t), AVG(d), AVG(e) FROM s5
